summary: Rocket pioneer and Crowley disciple Jack Parsons performed the 1946 Babylon Working sex-magic rituals in Pasadena with L. Ron Hubbard, who then ran off with Parsons's girlfriend and savings.

evidence.note: Parsons born in Pasadena in 1914; childhood rocket experiments follow
Crowley's background and the OTO get their own segment
Parsons discovers Crowley in 1939 and joins the Pasadena OTO lodge
founding of JPL and Parsons's role in solid-fuel rocketry
Hubbard arrives at the Parsons house in 1945 after leaving naval hospital
Allied Enterprises boat scheme set up with Parsons's savings
the Babylon Working rituals with Hubbard as scribe, early 1946
Hubbard and Betty leave for the East Coast with Parsons's money; Crowley calls it a con
Parsons pushed out of JPL, loses clearance, dies in a 1952 explosion

notes: Title names Hubbard, but the story is built around Parsons and the Babylon Working; Hubbard is listed as secondary because the episode covers only his 1945-46 stint, not his life (lifetime rule). The 1969 Scientology statement and modern occultist views are brief codas, so covered_span ends at Parsons's death.
